windows.60: Recent visitor feedback for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library highlights concerns about the food service, with several reviews describing the menu as limited and the quality as poor or overpriced. Some guests noted issues with the food preparation and lack of variety, including complaints about specific items like grilled cheese and potato salad. Service and wait times were also mentioned in a few reviews, suggesting room for improvement in these areas. Overall, while the library experience itself received positive remarks, the food offerings and related service aspects need attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with the kitchen often unable to take orders during operating hours. Many found the food overpriced and of low quality, describing portions as small and some items as bland or poorly prepared. There were also complaints about the lack of drink options and the overall value for money. Service delays and menu limitations were recurring concerns that need to be addressed.
